verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API equivalents for several Customer Area actions. The Management API orders terminals "using API requests instead of the Customer Area", and refunds available in the Customer Area can also be issued through the Terminal API. Separate APIs cover disputes and terminal transactions, and OpenAPI definitions are published. However, there is no stated commitment to full UI/API parity, and some Customer Area tools (webhook event logs, delivery troubleshooting) show no documented API counterpart. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee or coverage matrix, API equivalents for Customer Area tools such as webhook logs and troubleshooting, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
You can also issue refunds from your Customer Area
You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
